evidence.quote: A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

observations.why: Descriptive self-labeling of the text's function — floated as context, no committed stance taken.

evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Unhedged categorical assertion presented as a defensible distinction, but no ratification or permanence language — claim, not decision or principle.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Creed-level formulation: identity-constitutive value stated as bedrock with no hedging, no argument offered — the speaker treats it as constitutive, not argued.

evidence.quote:

extractor has existing positioning to connect to.

observations.why: Meta-description of the document's own purpose — explanatory, not a committed stance; lower than claim because it narrates rather than asserts a position.

mints.name: PerspectiveAsKeptAsset
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the conviction here stated as a constitutive value the speaker keeps, rather than as a position they argue for?
